clips.title: The story
paras: At Ambermill, the Kirin Tor watch Dalaran as the city is rebuilt in the open. Their report carries intelligence the Deathstalkers seek.

The Scourge sacked Dalaran, and Archimonde brought down its towering spires during the Third War. Early in the rebuilding, the surviving magi removed the city's protective shield and began their work in the open. The Kirin Tor also keeps enclaves such as Ambermill in southeastern Silverpine Forest. Its wizards compile the Dalaran Status Report, which holds intelligence about the city's condition and draws the Deathstalkers' attention.
